classification.difficultyReason: Introduce a shared diagonal and coordinate side, angle and area calculations; choose addition or subtraction of component triangles.

content.prompt: Calculate the area of these shapes. Round to 1 d.p.

spec.description: Blue convex quadrilateral with upper-left, upper-right, rightmost and bottom-left corners. Clockwise edge labels are 4 m above, 2.5 m outside upper-right, 6 m outside lower-right, and 5 m outside left. Black internal arc and 65° label at bottom-left. No diagonal or vertex letters.
spec.mathematics: Included angle between 5 m and 6 m is 65°; the other sides are 4 m and 2.5 m.

answer.worked:
Join the upper-left and rightmost vertices. Let the diagonal be $d\text{ m}$ and the angle between the $4\text{ m}$ and $2.5\text{ m}$ sides be $\theta$.
$$\begin{align*}
d^2&=5^2+6^2-2(5)(6)\cos65^\circ\\[8pt]
\theta&=\cos^{-1}\left(\frac{4^2+2.5^2-d^2}{2(4)(2.5)}\right)\\[8pt]
A&=\frac12(5)(6)\sin65^\circ+\frac12(4)(2.5)\sin\theta\\[8pt]
A&\approx17.3\text{ m}^2
\end{align*}$$

spec.description: Blue quadrilateral with horizontal top edge and vertical upper-right edge. Matching black double ticks on those two edges and a black right-angle square at their common top-right corner. Right edge labelled 6 cm, lower sloping edge 7 cm below-right, left edge 10 cm outside left. No diagonal or vertex letters.
spec.mathematics: Perpendicular equal sides are each 6 cm; remaining sides are 7 cm and 10 cm.

answer.worked:
Join the top-left vertex to the lower end of the $6\text{ cm}$ side. Let the diagonal be $d\text{ cm}$ and the angle between the $10\text{ cm}$ and $7\text{ cm}$ sides be $\theta$.
$$\begin{align*}
d^2&=6^2+6^2-2(6)(6)\cos90^\circ=72\\[8pt]
\cos\theta&=\frac{10^2+7^2-72}{2(10)(7)}=0.55\\[8pt]
\theta&=\cos^{-1}(0.55)\\[8pt]
A&=\frac12(6)(6)\sin90^\circ+\frac12(10)(7)\sin\theta\\[8pt]
A&\approx47.2\text{ cm}^2
\end{align*}$$

spec.description: Blue concave quadrilateral with top apex, rightmost lower tip, inward notch and bottom-left tip. Outer left edge labelled 22 km, outer right edge 18 km, short notch edge 8 km below, and edge from bottom-left tip to notch 12 km below-right. Internal top label 58° without a visible arc. No joining diagonal or vertex letters.
spec.mathematics: Outer sides 22 km and 18 km enclose 58°; triangular notch sides are 12 km and 8 km. Source drawing is not to scale; retain its topology and label ownership.

answer.worked:
Join the two outer lower tips. Let their separation be $d\text{ km}$ and the notch angle between the $12\text{ km}$ and $8\text{ km}$ sides be $\phi$.
$$\begin{align*}
d^2&=22^2+18^2-2(22)(18)\cos58^\circ\\[8pt]
\phi&=\cos^{-1}\left(\frac{12^2+8^2-d^2}{2(12)(8)}\right)\\[8pt]
A&=\frac12(22)(18)\sin58^\circ-\frac12(12)(8)\sin\phi\\[8pt]
A&\approx151.4\text{ km}^2
\end{align*}$$
